name: The Tsolenka Gate
summary: The road to the Amber Temple crosses the Tsolenka Pass, through a guard tower whose portcullis has been down for centuries.

stages.journal: High in the Tsolenka Pass, a guard tower straddles the road to the Amber Temple with its portcullis down. The watch is still on duty. The watch has been dead for a very long time.
objectives: Raise the gate from the winch room

stages.journal: The Tsolenka watch no longer stands between us and the gate.
objectives: Raise the gate from the winch room

stages.journal: The Tsolenka portcullis is up. The road climbs on into the cloud, toward the Amber Temple.
